info.name: Generative Marketing Collateral API
info.description:
ML6 Case 2 — two-endpoint API: upload two companies' context PDFs, then generate a tailored, factually-grounded B2B article as layout-valid structured JSON.

BASE URL is preset to the deployed Cloud Run service (edit the `baseUrl` collection variable for local: http://localhost:8000).

AUTH: in demo mode no token is needed. When the service runs with AUTH_MODE=google, set the `token` collection variable to a Google ID token:
  gcloud auth print-identity-token --audiences={{baseUrl}}
(The collection sends it as a Bearer token on every request.)

TYPICAL FLOW:
  1. Upload sender PDF  (pick sample_data/sender_nimbus_ai.pdf)
  2. Upload receiver PDF (pick sample_data/receiver_vanguard_freight.pdf)
  3. Get briefs — poll until both sender and receiver are non-null
  4. Generate — returns 202 + job_id (auto-saved to a variable by a test script)
  5. Poll generation — until status=done; ArticleJSON is under `result`.

request.description: Lists the layout templates (built-in + any this tenant has created). Also the recommended liveness check — use this instead of /healthz, which Google's front end shadows on *.run.app.

Create a custom layout template (tenant-scoped). After this it appears in GET /templates and the UI dropdown, and can be passed as template_id to /generate. Validated: unique block ids, min<=max words, 6-digit hex palette, each block theme_color must be one of the palette colours. 201 on success; 409 if the id collides with a built-in or an existing template; 422 on a malformed body. Block types: heading, subheading, body, caption, cta.
Replace a custom template (full update). The body `id` must match the path `{{template_id}}`. Built-ins are read-only. 200 on success; 409 built-in; 400 id mismatch; 404 not found; 422 invalid body.
Delete a custom template (tenant-scoped). 200 {deleted}; 409 if it's a built-in (read-only); 404 if it doesn't exist.

Upload the SENDER company's PDF. In the 'files' form field, choose sample_data/sender_nimbus_ai.pdf. Parsed asynchronously into a typed brief; returns a job_id. (Enable the X-Tenant-ID header to exercise multi-tenancy.)
Upload the RECEIVER company's PDF. In the 'files' form field, choose sample_data/receiver_vanguard_freight.pdf.
Returns the stored sender/receiver briefs. Poll until BOTH are non-null before generating.

exec: console.log('saved pair_id=' + j.pair_id + ', job_id=' + j.job_id + ' -> open "5. Poll generation" and hit Send');

body.raw: {"pair_id": "{{pair_id}}", "prompt": "Show how Nimbus cuts Vanguard's idle fleet hours and improves on-time delivery", "template_id": "one_pager_v1"}

request.description: Starts generation. Returns 202 + job_id immediately (never blocks on the model). A test script auto-saves job_id to the collection variable so the Poll request just works. Enable the Idempotency-Key header to make retries return the same job.

exec: if (!id && Array.isArray(r.blocks)) { var b = r.blocks.filter(function(x){ return x.image_ref; })[0]; if (b) { id = b.image_ref; } }
if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('asset_id', id); console.log('saved asset_id=' + id + ' -> the Get asset request now works'); }

request.description: Open this right after Generate and hit Send — {{pair_id}} and {{job_id}} are auto-filled from the Generate response (no need to copy the poll path, and note the variable is {{baseUrl}} with a capital U). Poll until status=done; the finished ArticleJSON (blocks, confidence, constraints, faithfulness, token/cost) is under `result`.
Status of an upload/parse job — use the job_id returned by an Upload request.
All jobs for the pair (parse + generate), newest first, each with kind/status/created_at/updated_at. Enable the query params to filter by type or status, or cap with limit.

Fetch an image/logo extracted from the PDFs during parsing. asset_id is NOT arbitrary — use a real one: from GET /companies/{pair} (each brief's images[].id and logo_asset, e.g. receiver0_img_1_0) or a generated article's assets map / a block image_ref. The Poll request auto-saves one into {{asset_id}}, so after polling a done article this just works. Returns the PNG/JPEG bytes; 404 if the id is empty or doesn't exist for this pair.
Delete an extracted image/logo asset. 200 {deleted}; 404 if the asset_id doesn't exist for this pair.
